Varsity Hackathon 2026 - Kuala Lumpur
Theme: Smart Campus

Judging criteria
Innovation and originality — 30 points
Technical implementation — 30 points
Social impact — 20 points
Pitch presentation — 20 points
Total: 100 points

Rules
1. Teams of 3 to 5 students from any Malaysian university.
2. All code must be written during the 36-hour event.
3. Teams that go over the 5-minute pitch limit lose 5 points.
